testTitle: Haryana Police Constable - Full Mock Test 01

questions.q_en: As per Haryana Economic Survey 2024-25, what is the estimated Per Capita Income of Haryana at current prices?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा आर्थिक सर्वेक्षण 2024-25 के अनुसार, मौजूदा कीमतों पर हरियाणा की अनुमानित प्रति व्यक्ति आय (Per Capita Income) क्या है?
questions.explanation: As per the latest Economic Survey 2024-25, Haryana's Per Capita Income has risen to ₹3,53,182.

questions.q_en: Under the new Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) 2023, which section specifically defines and punishes 'Mob Lynching' (murder by a group on grounds of race, caste, etc.)?
questions.q_hi: नई भारतीय न्याय संहिता (BNS) 2023 के तहत, कौन सी धारा विशेष रूप से 'मॉब लिंचिंग' (जाति, समुदाय आदि के आधार पर समूह द्वारा हत्या) को परिभाषित और दंडित करती है?
questions.explanation: Section 103(2) of BNS specifically deals with murder committed by a group of 5 or more persons acting in concert (Mob Lynching).

questions.q_en: Under the 'Mera Pani Meri Virasat' scheme, the incentive for farmers switching from paddy to alternative crops has been increased to how much per acre in 2024?
questions.q_hi: 'मेरा पानी मेरी विरासत' योजना के तहत, धान की जगह वैकल्पिक फसलें उगाने वाले किसानों के लिए प्रोत्साहन राशि 2024 में बढ़ाकर कितनी प्रति एकड़ कर दी गई है?
questions.explanation: The Haryana government increased the incentive from ₹7,000 to ₹8,000 per acre to promote crop diversification.

questions.q_en: In Python language, which of the following is an immutable data type?
questions.q_hi: पायथन (Python) भाषा में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा डेटा टाइप अपरिवर्तनीय (Immutable) है?
questions.explanation: Tuples are immutable sequences in Python, meaning their elements cannot be changed after assignment. Lists and Dictionaries are mutable.

questions.q_en: Which of the following causes 'Red Rot' disease in Sugarcane?
questions.q_hi: गन्ने में 'लाल सड़न' (Red Rot) रोग निम्नलिखित में से किसके कारण होता है?
questions.explanation: Red Rot is a fungal disease caused by Colletotrichum falcatum.

questions.q_en:
Match the 1857 Revolt leaders with their respective regions in Haryana:
1. Ghafur Ali  -  A. Farrukhnagar
2. Ahmed Ali  -  B. Pataudi
3. Nahar Singh -  C. Ballabhgarh
Select the correct code.
questions.q_hi:
हरियाणा में 1857 की क्रांति के नेताओं को उनके क्षेत्र के साथ सुमेलित करें:
1. गफूर अली  -  A. फर्रुखनगर
2. अहमद अली  -  B. पटौदी
3. नाहर सिंह -  C. बल्लभगढ़
सही कोड चुनें।
questions.explanation: Ghafur Ali led from Pataudi, Ahmed Ali from Farrukhnagar, and Raja Nahar Singh from Ballabhgarh.

questions.q_en: What is the average gestation period of a 'Sheep'?
questions.q_hi: 'भेड़' (Sheep) का औसत गर्भकाल (Gestation period) कितना होता है?
questions.explanation: Sheep gestation period is approx 150 days. (Goat ~150, Pig ~114, Cow ~280, Buffalo ~310).

questions.q_en: Which gas is known as 'Tear Gas' used by police for riot control?
questions.q_hi: पुलिस द्वारा भीड़ नियंत्रण के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली 'आंसू गैस' (Tear Gas) किसे कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Chloropicrin (or CS gas) is commonly used as tear gas. Nitrous oxide is laughing gas.

questions.q_en: The famous folk theatre form 'Saang' was started in Haryana by whom?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा में प्रसिद्ध लोक रंगमंच 'सांग' (Saang) की शुरुआत किसके द्वारा मानी जाती है?
questions.explanation: Kishan Lal Bhat (from Meerut) is considered the father/originator of Saang in this region (approx 1730 AD).

questions.q_en: A sum of money doubles itself in 4 years at Compound Interest. In how many years will it become 8 times?
questions.q_hi: चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर कोई धनराशि 4 वर्षों में दोगुनी हो जाती है। यह कितने वर्षों में 8 गुनी हो जाएगी?
questions.explanation: 2^1 in 4 years. 8 is 2^3. So time = 4 * 3 = 12 years.

questions.q_en: If 1st January 2024 was a Monday, what day of the week lies on 1st January 2025?
questions.q_hi: यदि 1 जनवरी 2024 को सोमवार था, तो 1 जनवरी 2025 को सप्ताह का कौन सा दिन होगा?
questions.explanation: 2024 is a leap year (366 days). It has 2 odd days. So Monday + 2 = Wednesday.

questions.q_en: Which statement is true regarding the 'Tangri River'?
questions.q_hi: 'टांगरी नदी' के संबंध में कौन सा कथन सत्य है?
options_en: It is a tributary of Markanda river
options_hi: इसका उद्गम हिमाचल प्रदेश से होता है
यह मारकंडा नदी की सहायक नदी है
यह सीधे यमुना में मिलती है
questions.explanation: Tangri originates from Morni Hills (Haryana itself) and is a tributary of the Markanda river.

questions.q_en: What is the full form of 'SMPS' in computer hardware?
questions.q_hi: कंप्यूटर हार्डवेयर में 'SMPS' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
questions.explanation: SMPS stands for Switched Mode Power Supply.

questions.q_en: 'Pusa 1121' is a famous variety of which crop?
questions.q_hi: 'पूसा 1121' किस फसल की एक प्रसिद्ध किस्म है?
questions.explanation: Pusa 1121 is a high-yielding variety of Basmati Rice.

questions.q_en: Which section of BNS 2023 replaces the controversial 'Sedition' (Section 124A IPC) law?
questions.q_hi: BNS 2023 की कौन सी धारा विवादास्पद 'राजद्रोह' (धारा 124A IPC) कानून की जगह लेती है?
options_hi: राजद्रोह पूरी तरह समाप्त कर दिया गया है
questions.explanation: Section 152 of BNS addresses 'Acts endangering sovereignty, unity and integrity of India', replacing the old Sedition law.

questions.q_en: Which inscription mentions the name 'Haryana' for the first time as 'Dharti Hariyanaka'?
questions.q_hi: किस अभिलेख में पहली बार 'हरियाणा' नाम का उल्लेख 'धरती हरियाणक' के रूप में मिलता है?
questions.explanation: The Palam Baoli Inscription (1328 AD) found in Delhi mentions the name 'Haryana' clearly.

questions.q_en: What is the pH value of human blood?
questions.q_hi: मानव रक्त (Blood) का pH मान कितना होता है?
questions.explanation: Human blood is slightly alkaline with a pH of approx 7.35 to 7.45.

questions.q_en: In the Haryana Budget 2024-25, which sector received the highest allocation?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा बजट 2024-25 में, किस क्षेत्र को सबसे अधिक आवंटन प्राप्त हुआ?
questions.explanation: Education usually receives the highest share (around 14-15%) in Haryana budget allocations.

questions.q_en: In C++, which symbol is used for the 'Scope Resolution Operator'?
questions.q_hi: C++ में, 'स्कोप रेजोल्यूशन ऑपरेटर' के लिए किस प्रतीक (symbol) का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.explanation: The double colon (::) is the scope resolution operator in C++.

questions.q_en: Where is the 'Central Sheep Breeding Farm' located in Haryana?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा में 'केंद्रीय भेड़ प्रजनन फार्म' कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: It is located in Hisar, established in 1968-70.

questions.q_en:
Statement: All mangoes are apples. No apple is a grape.
Conclusion I: No mango is a grape.
Conclusion II: Some apples are mangoes.
questions.q_hi:
कथन: सभी आम सेब हैं। कोई सेब अंगूर नहीं है।
निष्कर्ष I: कोई आम अंगूर नहीं है।
निष्कर्ष II: कुछ सेब आम हैं।
options_hi: I और II दोनों अनुसरण करते हैं
questions.explanation: If all M are A, and No A is G, then No M can be G (True). Since All M are A, some part of A is M (True).

questions.q_en: A does 20% work in 4 days. B does 33.33% work in 10 days. They worked together for 9 days. C completed the remaining work in 6 days. C alone can do the whole work in?
questions.q_hi: A 20% काम 4 दिनों में करता है। B 33.33% काम 10 दिनों में करता है। उन्होंने 9 दिनों तक एक साथ काम किया। C ने शेष कार्य 6 दिनों में पूरा किया। C अकेला पूरा कार्य कितने दिनों में कर सकता है?
questions.explanation: A whole work=20 days. B whole=30 days. LCM=60 units. Eff: A=3, B=2. Together(A+B)=5. 9 days work=45 units. Rem=15. C does 15 in 6 days => Eff C = 2.5. Total time for C = 60/2.5 = 24 days. (Wait, let's recheck logic: 15/6 = 2.5 units/day. 60/2.5 = 24. Options don't match explanation. Let's adjust question to fit option or answer. If C completes rem in 6 days. A(20), B(30). (A+B) 9 days = 45. Rem 15. C=15/6=2.5. 60/2.5=24. If option is 18/20/etc, maybe error in my calc or options provided. Let's keep question simple for JSON). *Corrected Question Logic*: Let A=20 days, B=30 days. Work=60. A+B=5/day. Work for 9 days=45. Rem=15. If C does it in 6 days, C eff=2.5. Total time=24. Okay, I will put 24 in options.

questions.q_en: A completes a work in 20 days and B in 30 days. They work together for 9 days, and the remaining work is done by C in 6 days. In how many days can C alone complete the work?
questions.q_hi: A एक काम को 20 दिनों में और B 30 दिनों में पूरा करता है। वे 9 दिनों तक एक साथ काम करते हैं, और शेष काम C 6 दिनों में पूरा करता है। C अकेला उस काम को कितने दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है?
questions.explanation: Total work = 60 units. A's eff=3, B's eff=2. (A+B)=5. Work in 9 days = 5*9=45. Remaining = 15. C does 15 units in 6 days -> C's eff = 2.5. Total days for C = 60/2.5 = 24.

questions.q_en: Who wrote the famous Haryanvi poetry 'Dahine Haath Ka Shankh'?
questions.q_hi: प्रसिद्ध हरियाणवी रचना 'दाहिने हाथ का शंख' किसके द्वारा लिखी गई थी?
questions.explanation: Syed Ghulam Bhik (Narang) wrote 'Dahine Haath Ka Shankh'.

questions.q_en: Which of the following hormones is injected into cows/buffaloes to make them release milk?
questions.q_hi: गाय/भैंस को दूध उतारने (release) के लिए निम्नलिखित में से किस हार्मोन का इंजेक्शन लगाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: Oxytocin promotes the let-down of milk.

questions.q_en: As per the Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act 2019, what is the penalty for 'Driving without a License'?
questions.q_hi: मोटर वाहन (संशोधन) अधिनियम 2019 के अनुसार, 'बिना लाइसेंस के वाहन चलाने' पर कितना जुर्माना है?
questions.explanation: The fine has been increased from ₹500 to ₹5,000.

questions.q_en: The 'Ror' community in Haryana is primarily concentrated in which belt?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा में 'रोड़' (Ror) समुदाय मुख्य रूप से किस क्षेत्र में केंद्रित है?
questions.explanation: The Ror Maratha community is heavily concentrated in the Karnal, Kurukshetra, and Panipat belt.

questions.q_en: Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for 'Routing'?
questions.q_hi: OSI मॉडल की कौन सी परत (Layer) 'रूटिंग' (Routing) के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
questions.explanation: The Network Layer (Layer 3) handles IP addressing and Routing.

questions.q_en: Which part of the brain controls body balance and posture?
questions.q_hi: मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग शरीर के संतुलन और मुद्रा (posture) को नियंत्रित करता है?
questions.explanation: Cerebellum is responsible for voluntary movements, balance, and posture.

questions.q_en: From which site in Haryana were the 'Seals of Harappan Civilization' found depicting a unicorn?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा के किस स्थल से 'हड़प्पा सभ्यता की मुहरें' मिली हैं जिन पर एक सींग वाला पशु (unicorn) चित्रित है?
questions.explanation: Harappan seals have been found in Banawali, Rakhigarhi, and Bhirrana.

questions.q_en: What is the maximum punishment for 'Snatching' under Section 304 of BNS 2023?
questions.q_hi: BNS 2023 की धारा 304 के तहत 'स्नैचिंग' (Snatching) के लिए अधिकतम सजा क्या है?
questions.explanation: Under Sec 304(1) BNS, snatching is punishable with imprisonment up to 3 years.

questions.q_en: Which soil in Haryana is locally known as 'Solar' or 'Chika'?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा में किस मिट्टी को स्थानीय रूप से 'सolar' या 'चीका' कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Hard Clayey soil which cracks when dry is called 'Solar' or 'Chika' in Haryana.

questions.q_en: How many seats are reserved for Scheduled Castes (SC) in the Haryana Vidhan Sabha?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा विधानसभा में अनुसूचित जाति (SC) के लिए कितनी सीटें आरक्षित हैं?
questions.explanation: Out of 90 seats, 17 are reserved for SC candidates.

questions.q_en: Which protocol is used for sending emails?
questions.q_hi: ईमेल भेजने के लिए किस प्रोटोकॉल का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.explanation: SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) is used for sending, while POP3/IMAP are for receiving.

questions.q_en: Which district of Haryana shares its boundary with two states and one Union Territory?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा का कौन सा जिला दो राज्यों और एक केंद्र शासित प्रदेश के साथ अपनी सीमा साझा करता है?
questions.explanation: Panchkula touches Punjab, Himachal Pradesh, and the UT of Chandigarh.

questions.q_en: A boat goes 12 km upstream and returns in 3 hours. If the speed of the current is 3 km/hr, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.q_hi: एक नाव 12 किमी धारा के प्रतिकूल जाती है और 3 घंटे में वापस आती है। यदि धारा की गति 3 किमी/घंटा है, तो शांत जल में नाव की गति ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Let boat speed=x. Time = 12/(x-3) + 12/(x+3) = 3. Solving this quadratic eq (or trying options), if x=9: 12/6 + 12/12 = 2+1=3 hours. Correct.

questions.q_en: Which disease in poultry is also known as 'New Castle Disease'?
questions.q_hi: कुक्कुट (Poultry) में किस रोग को 'न्यू कैसल रोग' (New Castle Disease) के नाम से भी जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation: Ranikhet disease is internationally known as New Castle Disease.

questions.q_en: The 'Haryana Orbital Rail Corridor' project will run from?
questions.q_hi: 'हरियाणा ऑर्बिटल रेल कॉरिडोर' परियोजना कहाँ से कहाँ तक चलेगी?
questions.explanation: It connects Palwal to Sonipat via Sohna, Manesar, and Kharkhoda.

questions.q_en: Bronze is an alloy of which metals?
questions.q_hi: कांस्य (Bronze) किन धातुओं की मिश्र धातु है?
questions.explanation: Bronze is Copper + Tin. Brass is Copper + Zinc.

questions.q_en: Who established the 'Jat Gazette' newspaper in 1916?
questions.q_hi: 1916 में 'जाट गजट' समाचार पत्र की स्थापना किसने की थी?
questions.explanation: Sir Chhotu Ram started the Urdu weekly 'Jat Gazette' from Rohtak in 1916.

questions.q_en: What will be the output of print(2**3) in Python?
questions.q_hi: Python में print(2**3) का आउटपुट क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: ** operator is used for exponentiation (power). 2^3 = 8.

questions.q_en: Which revolution is related to 'Fertilizer Production'?
questions.q_hi: 'उर्वरक उत्पादन' (Fertilizer Production) से कौन सी क्रांति संबंधित है?
questions.explanation: Grey Revolution relates to Fertilizers. (Note: Sometimes Brown is used for leather/cocoa, Pink for onion/prawn).

questions.q_en: Which Haryanvi wrestler won the Bronze medal at the 2024 Paris Olympics? (Hypothetical/Current Trend based)
questions.q_hi: किस हरियाणवी पहलवान ने 2024 पेरिस ओलंपिक में कांस्य पदक जीता? (अमन सेहरावत)
questions.explanation: Aman Sehrawat (from Birohar, Jhajjar) won the Bronze in Wrestling at Paris 2024.

questions.q_en: Find the missing number: 6, 13, 28, 59, ?
Organized Crime is defined under which section of the BNS 2023?
questions.q_hi: BNS 2023 की किस धारा के तहत 'संगठित अपराध' (Organized Crime) को परिभाषित किया गया है?
questions.explanation: Section 111 of BNS introduces a specific provision for Organized Crime syndicates.

questions.q_en: The 'Gorakhpur Nuclear Power Plant' in Fatehabad has a total planned capacity of?
questions.q_hi: फतेहाबाद में 'गोरखपुर परमाणु ऊर्जा संयंत्र' की कुल नियोजित क्षमता कितनी है?
questions.explanation: It will have 4 units of 700 MW each, totaling 2800 MW.

questions.q_en: Which vitamin contains Cobalt?
questions.q_hi: किस विटामिन में कोबाल्ट (Cobalt) पाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin) contains Cobalt.

questions.q_en: In binary arithmetic, what is 1010 + 0101?
Who served as the Chief Minister of Haryana for the longest duration (cumulative days)?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा के मुख्यमंत्री के रूप में सबसे लंबी अवधि (संचयी दिनों में) तक किसने कार्य किया?
questions.explanation: Chaudhary Bhajan Lal holds the record for the longest cumulative tenure (approx 4317 days). Bansi Lal is close second.

questions.q_en: The practice of growing two or more crops simultaneously in the same field in definite row patterns is called?
questions.q_hi: एक ही खेत में निश्चित पंक्ति पैटर्न में एक साथ दो या दो से अधिक फसलें उगाने की प्रथा को क्या कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Inter-cropping involves specific row patterns (e.g., 1 row of maize, 2 rows of soyabean). Mixed cropping has no set pattern.

questions.q_en: The 'Chor Gumbad' (Dome of Thieves) is located in which town?
questions.q_hi: 'चोर गुंबद' किस शहर में स्थित है?
questions.explanation: Chor Gumbad built by Jamal Khan is a famous landmark in Narnaul.

questions.q_en: The ratio of the ages of A and B is 3:5. 5 years hence, the ratio will be 2:3. What is A's present age?
questions.q_hi: A और B की आयु का अनुपात 3:5 है। 5 वर्ष बाद, अनुपात 2:3 होगा। A की वर्तमान आयु क्या है?

questions.q_en: In a certain code, 'HARYANA' is written as 'SZIZZMZ'. How is 'POLICE' written?
questions.q_hi: एक निश्चित कोड में, 'HARYANA' को 'SZIZZMZ' लिखा जाता है। 'POLICE' को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
questions.explanation: It is a Reverse Alphabet code (A<->Z, H<->S). P->K, O->L, L->O, I->R, C->X, E->V. (Correction: I->R. Option 2 has I->I? Wait. I opposite is R. Let's check options. KLORXV: P-K, O-L, L-O, I-R, C-X, E-V. Wait, P opposite is K (PK movie). O is L (Love). L is O. I is R (Indian Railway). C is X (Crux). E is V (EV). So KLORXV. Correct answer is option A).

questions.q_en: According to the 2011 Census, which district of Haryana had the lowest Population Density?
questions.q_hi: 2011 की जनगणना के अनुसार, हरियाणा के किस जिले का जनसंख्या घनत्व सबसे कम था?
questions.explanation: Sirsa has the lowest density of 303 persons/sq km.

questions.q_en: Which of the following IP addresses is a Class C address?

questions.q_en: A clock shows 4:30. If the minute hand points East, in which direction does the hour hand point?
questions.q_hi: एक घड़ी 4:30 का समय दिखाती है। यदि मिनट की सुई पूर्व (East) की ओर इशारा करती है, तो घंटे की सुई किस दिशा में होगी?
questions.explanation: At 4:30, minute hand is at 6 (South normally). Hour hand is at 4.5. If Min hand (South) is East (rotated 90 deg anti-clockwise), then Hour hand (South-East normally) rotated 90 deg anti-clockwise becomes North-East.

questions.q_en: Which district is known as the 'City of Cotton'?

questions.explanation: Palwal is historically known as the City of Cotton (though Sirsa produces more now, the nickname sticks to Palwal often, but Sirsa is Cotton City too. In HSSC, if Palwal is option for 'Cotton City' usually they mean Palwal due to trade history. But Sirsa is 'Saraswati/Cotton'. Let's stick to **Palwal** being traditionally called Cotton City in old GK, but **Sirsa** is highest producer. *Correction*: Palwal is Cotton City. Sirsa is Wheat bowl/Cotton hub. For this Q, Palwal is the GK answer often asked).

questions.q_en: The average of 5 consecutive odd numbers is 61. What is the difference between the highest and lowest numbers?
questions.q_hi: 5 लगातार विषम संख्याओं का औसत 61 है। सबसे बड़ी और सबसे छोटी संख्या के बीच का अंतर क्या है?
questions.explanation: Difference in 5 consecutive odd numbers is always (5-1)*2 = 8. (Example: 57, 59, 61, 63, 65. 65-57=8).

questions.q_en: A sphere of radius 3 cm is melted and recast into small spheres of radius 1 cm. How many such spheres can be made?
questions.q_hi: 3 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले एक गोले को पिघलाकर 1 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले छोटे गोले बनाए जाते हैं। ऐसे कितने गोले बनाए जा सकते हैं?
questions.explanation: Volume ratio = (R/r)^3 = (3/1)^3 = 27.

questions.q_en: The LCM of two numbers is 1920 and their HCF is 16. If one of the numbers is 128, find the other number.
questions.q_hi: दो संख्याओं का LCM 1920 है और उनका HCF 16 है। यदि उनमें से एक संख्या 128 है, तो दूसरी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: LCM * HCF = Product of numbers. 1920 * 16 = 128 * x. x = (1920*16)/128 = 240.
